metadata.scope: Proposed TSX/TSXV gold-development disclosure window2018-2022; global project locations.
metadata.identifiers: All keys in this fixture are human research labels; NO canonical issuer/security/asset/event IDs have been minted or bound.
metadata.date_basis: Calendar disclosure dates. No exchange first-known timestamp or historical system-possession proof.
metadata.Cote_conflict: Conflicting operating-date assertions remain CONFLICT even though both fall after the24month deadline. Public declaration and contractual trigger retain separate target identities.

sources.title: Pure Gold construction finance and board decision
sources.note: Board approved construction; target first gold by end2020. Named mine used existing infrastructure; not a new greenfield-only observation.

sources.title: PureGold commercial declaration
sources.note: Issuer declared commercial production effective1Aug2021. This is not a cash-flow or return result.

sources.title: PureGold financial and operations update
sources.note: Immediate suspension; C$2m cash, C$13m net working-capital deficit excluding current Sprott debt; expected warrant exercises absent; no consistent positive site cash flow.

sources.title: PureGold obtains CCAA protection
sources.note: Court-protection order is a distinct milestone, not proof of equity extinguishment or recovery amount.

sources.title: IAMGOLD proceeds with Cote construction
sources.note: 70/30 joint venture; expected commercial production H2 2023. Whole company already had operating assets.

sources.title: IAMGOLD commercial declaration
sources.note: Declaration2Aug; threshold30consecutive days averaging60% of36,000tpd. Reaching commercial threshold does not establish sustained nameplate.

sources.title: IAMGOLD Q2 results
sources.note: Reports operating commercial2Aug and JV-contract effective1Sep; 70% assets/liabilities versus60.3% revenues/costs before repurchase. Do not use one ownership percentage everywhere.

sources.title: IAMGOLD Q3 results
sources.note: Later report calls operating commercial1Aug while retaining2Aug announcement and1Sep contractual trigger. Date assertions require adjudication, not latest-wins.

sources.title: Sabina financing package
sources.note: US$520m package; additional third-party equity and bridge repayment were conditions before funding. Financing proposal is a landmark, not proof of cash available.

sources.title: Sabina formal Goose construction decision
sources.note: Formal build decision after early logistics; first production Q1 2025. Keep this native target wording, not commercial production.

sources.title: B2Gold completes Sabina acquisition
sources.note: Completed0.3867 B2Gold common shares per Sabina share. Expected delisting date is not an observed exchange delisting receipt.

sources.title: B2Gold first gold at Goose
sources.note: First gold30Jun2025 after first ore24Jun. Current corporate page boilerplate is not historical portfolio evidence.

sources.title: Marathon Valentine construction decision
sources.note: StartQ42022/majorwork2023; first gold early2025. Early2025 is deliberately not coerced to Q1.

sources.title: Ascot Premier construction finance
sources.note: Closed finance package has staged funding; part refinances notes. Brownfield restart, not a greenfield-only project.

sources.title: Ascot proposed replacement construction financing
sources.note: Non-binding financing proposal. Same project as2020; do not count two independent investments.

sources.title: Ascot first gold during commissioning
sources.note: First pour20Apr2024; commissioning continues; commercial targetQ3 remains a forecast.

sources.title: Ascot suspension for mine development
sources.note: Near/design mill rates did not supply enough developed stopes and ore feed. C$15m cash supports suspension/compliance, not a confirmed restart budget.

sources.title: Victoria Gold financing and continuation
sources.note: Explicit continuation of construction. Financing belongs in a separate landmark; first construction within2018 is not established.

sources.title: Equinox groundbreaking full-scale construction
sources.note: 60/40 JV announcement; separate quarterly footnote retains formal-decision conditions.

sources.title: Equinox Q3 conditional decision qualification
sources.note: Formal construction decision subject to lender consent and Orion financing. This later qualification is not silently backdated to27Oct.

sources.title: Argonaut approves Magino build
sources.note: Board approval; target first goldH12023. Funding includes assumed operating-mine cash generation and conditional asset sale, not cash alone.

sources.title: Artemis credit-approved commitment letter
sources.note: Credit-approved letter is financing progress, not an observed loan draw.

sources.title: Artemis site earthworks
sources.note: Site preparation can commence while major construction still requires Mines Act permits. Dated body says TSXV; current page header says TSX. Use the dated source span.

sources.title: Alamos La Yaqui Grande construction decision
sources.note: Satellite/replacement operation within Mulatos. Listed issuer is already producing; retain a different financial perimeter.

sources.title: Harte Gold year-end2018 results
sources.note: Earthworks beganSep2017 and mill erectionDec2017. This prior-works control does not exclude separate2018 financing landmarks or prove the date of formal FID.

sources.title: G Mining Tocantinzinho funding
sources.note: Reuses R1/R2 financing source and R3 capital uncertainty; not a newly qualified technical report.

sources.title: NRCan major projects inventory methodology
sources.note: Indexed description: Canadian-located projects over stated cost thresholds; not a global Toronto-listed population. Direct page403 was not bypassed.

sources.title: NRCan historical project inventory changes
sources.note: Indexed descriptions distinguish additions, completed and inactive removals across annual snapshots. A current inventory omits relevant old entrants. Direct inventory403 not rerouted.

sources.title: TMX current statistics and archive navigation
sources.note: Historical issuer rosters are a required input, not obtained by reading a latest statistics page. Direct page403 stopped; no complete listing census.
